# Mert Güneş

> Mechatronics Engineer & AI Specialist based in Istanbul, Turkey.
> Specializing in AI workflows, RAG architectures, local LLM deployment, autonomous mechatronic systems, and full-stack software development.

## Summary & Profile
Mert Güneş is a technology professional operating at the intersection of Mechatronics Engineering and Artificial Intelligence. He builds end-to-end autonomous solutions, local document-grounded AI assistants (RAG), automated workflows (n8n), and high-performance web applications.

## Key Capabilities & Technical Stack
- **AI Automation & LLMs**: Local RAG Architectures, OpenAI Whisper v3, Qwen 2.5, Llama 3, Qdrant Vector DB, Ollama, n8n Workflow Automation.
- **Mechatronics & Robotics**: Embedded Systems, PLC Programming, Sensor Integration, Control Systems, Microcontrollers.
- **Full-Stack Software**: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python, Docker, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS.

## Key Projects
- **Offline Voice Assistant (RAG)**: Completely air-gapped, on-prem voice assistant using Whisper v3, Qwen 2.5, and Qdrant for document semantic querying.
- **Automated AI Workflows**: n8n-powered autonomous agents and data processing pipelines.
